newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp buys PET technology stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp buys PET technology stake.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had purchased a 50 percent stake in the Innovations in PET Pty Ltd (Inpet) development company, which would give it distinct advantages in the use of recycled plastic materials.

Southcorp said the rest of the company was owned by SWIG Pty Ltd, a company associated with the inventor of the Renew process, which would enable PET plastic containers such as bottles to be made of up to 100 percent recycled PET material. This would provide Southcorp with distinct advantages compared to other processes using recycled material, it said.
